tools.resident.send_reply.card: the tool `send_reply`: Send your reply in words. Call this when your reply is text; a reaction GIF goes through `send_gif`.

tools.resident.now.card: the tool `now`: The current date and time, in this deployment's time zone. Call this before answering anything that depends on when it is.

tools.resident.web_search.card: the tool `web_search`: Look something up on the web. Call this when the answer is not in the conversation and no other tool covers it.

tools.resident.web_fetch.card: the tool `web_fetch`: Open a specific web page and read what's actually on it. Call this when somebody shares a LINK and asks about it.

tools.resident.note_read.card: the tool `note_read`: Read what a note in <notes> actually says, the only way to reach the note itself. Call this before note_update, always.

tools.resident.search_memory.card: the tool `search_memory`: Find where something was actually SAID in this group's history, in the exact words. Use it to recall a specific thing somebody said a long time ago.

tools.catalogue.card: <tool_catalogue>: everything you can do, one line per tool: its name, then when to reach for it. Needed whenever the turn calls, or should call, a tool beyond the always-loaded send_reply, now, web_search, web_fetch, note_read and search_memory.

skills.available.card: <available_skills>: the skills installed on this deployment, by name and when to load one.

runtime_context.card: <runtime_context>: Nora's display name in this room, what triggered this turn, and the room's default reply language.
